title: Botany feedback 6: primary harvest input and registered grinder slot cues
acceptance_criteria: Primary empty-hand block use reaches retention during hand-query refresh, with or without a retained snapshot; item targets, occupied hands, UI suppression, and outstanding actions remain excluded.
A retained use consumes fresh matching proof once without automatic retry of server denials.
Resolved grinder beaker cues use registered sound-event IDs; the registered recipient receives committed slot cue packets and busy or stale ejections remain silent.
Nonempty chamber ejection uses the existing switch cue once per successful batch; empty chamber ejection remains silent.

manual_steps: Restart with the candidate jar; empty-handed, click a ready tray shortly after another interaction and verify one click harvests without retries.
